title: The Allowance Quantity Limits Earn on a Ridgecrest RxSecure Approval
content:
Where the Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan held enforces quantity limits at the point of sale, an allowance is taken off the approval run, and its size is read from whether the member's own fills reach the preferred brand tier.

| The plan enforces quantity limits at the point of sale | Fills standing paid on the pharmacy record sitting on the preferred brand tier | The allowance taken off |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | 1 or more | 45 days |
| yes | none | 15 days |
| no | any | nothing |

The plan's quantity review allowance is 45 days and its shorter quantity review allowance is 15 days. Where the plan held enforces no quantity limits at the point of sale, no allowance is taken off at all, whatever tier the member's fills sit on.

## Boundary cases on a hypothetical record

- A plan that enforces quantity limits, with 1 fill standing paid on the preferred brand tier: 45 days is taken off.
- The same plan with 6 fills standing paid, none of them on the preferred brand tier: 15 days is taken off.
- The same plan with no fill standing paid at all: none sits on the preferred brand tier, so 15 days is taken off.
- A plan that enforces no quantity limits, with 3 fills standing paid on the preferred brand tier: nothing is taken off.
